messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Synthetic canary failures detected for 'inference-canary'
incident-bot: Regions affected: eu-west-1 (error spike), us-east-1 (timeouts). 5xx rate > 6% over 3m, latency p95 >> baseline.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Triggered oncall for incidents#3 — page_id: PD123456.
alice chen: Acked PD. Oncall here. Looking now. :eyes:
alice chen: Can someone paste last 10 failed probe logs? ops-bot, can you dump?
ops-bot: Fetching probe logs from eu-west-1 and us-east-1...
ops-bot: ```eu-west-1: 2026-03-14T09:12:32Z -> 502 backends. error: upstream timeout
us-east-1: 2026-03-14T09:12:35Z -> request timeout calling runtime-gw-03
probe: /health -> 200 usually, now 502/504s```
samir patel: I'm seeing increased KV cache misses on runtime nodes in eu-west-1, memory spikes on infer-node-12. Could be OOMs or sudden traffic pattern.
alice chen: Any deployments around 09:10? eng-releases?
devon liu: No major infra deploys. There was a small config push to canary-probes at 08:50 but it was dry-run. I rolled that back 09:05 automatically.
nina ramos: Customer impact check: early telemetry shows retries up for a handful of customers in EU, but fallback routing kept most traffic healthy. No major 5xx from customer endpoints yet. Marking potential partial impact.
alice chen: Good. Triage plan: 1) pause synthetic canaries to stop noise 2) scale up runtime pool in eu-west-1 temporarily 3) run targeted health checks against runtime-gw and model instances 4) if we see OOMs, roll nodes out-of-service and reprovision.
samir patel: I'll pause the canaries now. /pause-canary inference-canary --regions eu-west-1,us-east-1
ops-bot: Command accepted: paused canary inference-canary in eu-west-1, us-east-1.
samir patel: Kicking a sudo restart of runtime-gw group in eu-west-1: `for i in $(seq 1 3); do ssh runtime-gw-$i 'sudo systemctl restart inference-runtime'; done`
devon liu: I'm running `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide --selector=role=runtime` to find pods with CrashLoop or OOM.
ops-bot: runtime-gw-02 in eu-west-1 returned high RSS and OOMKilled 09:11:02Z (kernel). Marked for drain.
alice chen: Good catch. Samir, drain and reprovision that node. Nina, can you prepare the customer comms draft? We should avoid noisy pages to customers if fallback handled 90% of traffic.
nina ramos: Drafting: "We detected transient probe failures in eu-west-1 and us-east-1 affecting synthetic checks. Customer-facing traffic largely routed to healthy endpoints; any degradation would be brief. Investigating and will provide an update in 30m"
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Acknowledgement recorded by alice chen (oncall). Escalation to SRE secondary scheduled at +10m if unacked.
alice chen: Handoff note: devon, if this persists after I step out at 09:45 UTC I'll pass to Samir. For now I'm owning mitigation.
devon liu: Understood. I'll keep watching dashboards and look for any rollout artifacts.
samir patel: Node drained and reprovisioned. `kubectl cordon runtime-node-12 && kubectl drain runtime-node-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data` then reprovision triggered. New node came up healthy at 09:23:10Z.
ops-bot: Healthcheck sweep: runtime-gw and model pods in eu-west-1 now reporting steady 200s and latency back to baseline for p50/p95.
alice chen: Re-enable canaries in a minute to validate. If they stay green for 3 consecutive runs we'll close the page.
samir patel: Re-enabling canary: /resume-canary inference-canary --regions eu-west-1,us-east-1
ops-bot: Command accepted: resumed canary inference-canary. First run started.
ops-bot: Canary run results: eu-west-1 -> success, us-east-1 -> success. 0.2% 5xx.
alice chen: Nice. Closing PagerDuty incident. Leaving a short postmortem link for follow-up on root cause: potential memory leak in runtime component triggered under synthetic traffic pattern.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident closed by alice chen.
alice chen: Postmortem owner: devon liu. Assign to eng-runtime. Expected follow-up: heap dump + load-replay in staging, consider increasing OOM guard.
devon liu: Will file RCA ticket and include logs, heap traces, and a patch candidate. ETA EOD.
alice chen: Thanks team. Marking severity: sev3 - limited customer impact, quick mitigation. :white_check_mark:
